reason: Although framed as a refactor, this PR is concentrated entirely in `pkg/planner/core` and spans core plan-cache, plan-cloning, task selection, point-get, and index-join code paths. Plan cache changes are high-blast-radius because subtle mistakes can corrupt cached-plan reuse, rebuild logic, or optimizer/runtime correctness across many queries, so it merits a dedicated deep review for Blocker/High issues.
